what: The footer wordmark wider than the screen is split into letters, from when a letter row’s top edge touches the bottom of the screen until it has risen half its own height (top bottom → top+=50% bottom) each letter rises .05 later from 120% below into place — curve is the GSAP default power1.out, tied directly to scroll (scrub true)

options.y: Start position below before rising, default 120%
options.fan: Each letter starts at a staggered depth — the n-th letter in a word starts y + n×fan % lower, and all land in place together at the end (instead of sequential stagger, curve default none, paradox-series 25)
options.trigger: Closest ancestor (css) to measure instead of the text block — for rising while the whole footer is on screen (paradox-series .px-foot)

use:
Wordmark

— Give the wrapping panel overflow:hidden and the letters look like they rise from the bottom edge

from.where: shared.js footer .footer__typo-text (original footerScrollText — SplitType chars, gsap.from y 120% · stagger .05 · top bottom → top+=50% bottom · scrub true, 500ms after load)

index.html .px-foot__mark (footer bottom wordmark) — original .g-footer .svg-logo__path: translate 0 calc(100% + n×25% − p1 × (100% + n×25%)), n is the letter’s order within the word (P1 A2 R3 A4 D5 O6 X7 · S1 e2 r3 i4 e5 s6), p1 runs from when the footer touches the bottom of the screen until the footer’s bottom edge touches the bottom of the screen (no curve)
from.options: fan: 25; y: 100; trigger: .px-foot; start: top bottom; end: bottom bottom; ease: none
